fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without a disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior or Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale.
Proposed surrender, new lease, SPV negotiation and unactivated rent reviews are not treated as completed.
Seller adjustments, historic payments, stepped rents and gross/net income are kept distinct from passing rent.
Planning, residential conversion, redevelopment and alternative-use potential remain subject to consents.
Holding-over occupancy, inaccessible areas, plant warranties and receiver caveats are preserved.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current registry status.
